RACEBOARD.AddBox: Add a Box to this Track
RACEBOARD.RemoveBox: Remove a Box from this Track
RACEBOARD.ResetConfirm: Reset every Track to empty and clear all announced Winners? Track count and Labels are preserved.
RACEBOARD.DiscardConfirm: Permanently delete the RaceBoard "{name}"? If this is the only page in its Journal Entry, the Entry is removed too.
RACEBOARD.MinTracksReached: A RaceBoard must have at least {min} Track.
RACEBOARD.MaxTracksReached: A RaceBoard can have at most {max} Tracks.
RACEBOARD.SavePrompt: Name this RaceBoard. It will be created as a Journal page in the "RaceBoards" folder.
RACEBOARD.AlreadySaved: This RaceBoard is already saved — edits auto-save.
RACEBOARD.MarkEventTitle: Left-click to tick • Right-click to cycle event marker (none → red → amber)
RACEBOARD.RevealOnTitle: Players see the colored squares and alarm — click to hide them
RACEBOARD.RevealOffTitle: Players see only the plain board — click to reveal colored squares and alarm
RACEBOARD.AlarmIconTitle: Left-click to raise the alarm • Right-click to lower it
